metadata.case_name: LEUNG CHAU v. THE INCORPORATED OWNERS OF KWAI WAN INDUSTRIAL BUILDING AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_after: messenger / courier (employed by Delta Express; later with Hong Kong Courier Limited)

injuries.description: fractures of bones in my face which effected my teeth and ability to breath
source: I was taken to Princess Margaret Hospital – I had fractures of bones in my face which effected my teeth and ability to breath and an emergency operation was carried out to clear an airway.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures involving skull or facial bones

source: When the Plaintiff stepped forward towards the gates to find out what had happened, the inner gate moved and hit him. The Lift also suddenly sank and the Plaintiff’s jaw was injured.

manifestations.description: A depression of my left check-bone.
I cannot completely close both my eye-lids.

I have an “open bite” in that my upper and lower teeth do not close together as my lower teeth extend further then my upper teeth – this affects my ability to chew food and has affected the condition of my teeth and some have had to be removed.
I normally have to breathe through my mouth due to the blockage of my nasal air-passage.
My speech is slurred and unclear.
I suffer from stomach pain which was not present before the accident. I think is because I cannot chew my food properly and this affects my digestion.
When my eyes are open, compared to there appearance before the accident, my left eye opens much more fully and my right eye less fully giving my eyes a “lop-sided” appearance.
I have become depressed and more inclined to lose my temper with others.

treatments_received: Emergency operation to clear an airway
Operation two days after admission to help keep my teeth in position
Further operation on 11/9/90 in respect of the fractures
Follow-up treatment in the ENT Department of Princess Margaret Hospital
Follow-up treatment at South Kwai Chung Polyclinic
treatments_future: pull the left lower eyelid to a slightly higher level (Dr. Gordon Ma)
fat drafting procedure to the left upper eyelid to give more fullness (Dr. Gordon Ma)

losses.description: Severe cosmetic effect and altered appearance; very conscious of cosmetic effect affecting other people and mental/psychological impact.

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy food and drink
losses.description: Open bite and inability to chew food properly leading to digestion problems and loss of weight; some teeth removed.
Became depressed and more inclined to lose temper; affected mentally and psychologically.
Reduced prospects of obtaining better paid work and loss of opportunity on the open labour market because of appearance and speech problems.
Affected ability to make relationships because of appearance and speech problems.
